# Git Workspace Scan

Enumerates git repositories under a set of scan roots and upserts a `git-workspace` entity for every discovered repository or linked worktree. Repositories are keyed by a deterministic id derived from their normalized filesystem path so re-scans update rather than duplicate. For each root repository, linked worktrees are also enumerated (via `git worktree list` metadata) and recorded with their owning-repository path.

## Configuration

### `excludes`

A list of filesystem paths whose subtrees the scanner will skip. Any directory equal to, or lying under, an exclude entry (with a directory-separator boundary) is not descended into. Comparison is case-insensitive. The default value is `["%TEMP%"]` so the user's temporary directory is skipped out of the box; supplying an explicit `excludes` array replaces the default entirely.

### Environment-variable substitution

All scan-root and exclude paths are passed through `Environment.ExpandEnvironmentVariables`, so `%NAME%` references (for example `%TEMP%`, `%USERPROFILE%`, `%APPDATA%`) are resolved before matching or scanning. Env-var expansion applies to:

- `user-computer-profile` participant `home-directory` values,
- `filesystem-path` participant `path` values,
- entries in the `excludes` array.

### Scan roots

Scan roots come from the participants:

- If the tool relationship's `current-computer-user-profile` participant is a `user-computer-profile`, every fixed local drive root is scanned.
- Additional `user-computer-profile` participants for the current profile contribute their `home-directory` property as a scan root.
- Participants typed `filesystem-path` (belonging to the current profile) contribute their `path` property as a scan root.

Directory depth is unlimited (`int.MaxValue`) and cannot be changed via the entity.

## Usage

Wire the tool via a `tool-relationship`:

- `participants.tool` — the entity-id of this tool entity.
- `participants.target` (and other participant roles) — the `user-computer-profile` or `filesystem-path` entities whose paths should be scanned. Attach only entities belonging to the current computer-user-profile; others are ignored.
- `participants.schedule` — a `schedule` entity controlling scan cadence. A full-drive scan can be slow; scheduling it hourly or daily is typical.

Set `paused: true` on the relationship to disable scanning without deleting it. The tool logs `Scanned N root(s); found M repositories, indexed K worktree(s).` after each run.
